name: sweep-lowq
airframe: any jet, BELOW its corner speed at this entry condition
note: Same sustained-sweep shape as fixedwing-sweep, entered at 150 m/s instead of 250: below corner for every jet, so qSched (the low-q demand schedule) and the q-scaled omegaMax actually bind. Third point of the loading sweep: fixedwing-sweep = high q, this = low q, alpha-sweep = alpha-limited.
